content.short: Typus is a real-yield options protocol on Sui featuring automated DeFi Option Vaults for retail and pro traders.
content.description: Typus Finance is a leading decentralized options and derivatives protocol built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to maximize rewards for users through sophisticated risk management. The platform features automated DeFi Option Vaults that utilize a Dutch auction mechanism to simplify options trading for retail participants. This allows users to earn "real yield" generated from actual market demand for volatility, rather than relying on inflationary token emissions. Deeply integrated with the Sui ecosystem, Typus features the Tails by Typus dynamic NFT collection.
content.meta: Typus provides automated DeFi Option Vaults and high-efficiency real-yield strategies on Sui. Discover Typus and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
